answer: In an AI-agent economy a concrete sybil defense is the voyage-bound stake: every new identity must lock tokens for a full epoch while a public thread of peer attestations accumulates, and only after the sparrow-like quick peer checks clear does the stake unlock. An attacker must therefore fund many parallel locked positions across the same epoch, paying the full opportunity cost of capital that honest agents recycle, so forging a majority becomes prohibitively expensive.
